notes: Assumptions that move the number: 2 tbsp smooth peanut butter ≈ 32 g (191 kcal, a quarter of the total); whole-milk plain yoghurt; frozen berries ≈ 155 g a cup; 2 bananas × 115 g. Cross-check: published smoothie bowls with fruit, seeds and nut butter topping list ~350–450 kcal a bowl; 380 agrees. Published figures are recalled, not re-fetched (the shared web budget was spent).
